verdict.rationale: Supabase provides 'a full Postgres database' (supabase-docs-51) with RLS policies effectively adding WHERE-clause constraints (supabase-docs-36, supabase-docs-15), full-text search and auto-generated REST/GraphQL APIs from schema introspection (supabase-docs-18, supabase-gh-2), all of which implies standard SQL join/constraint capability. However, docs don't explicitly showcase join queries or multi-statement transaction handling via the client libraries, and community reports note PostgREST's limitations forced a return to a custom API server for complex relational needs (supabase-comm-10), indicating real friction for advanced relational queries at the API layer even though raw Postgres access supports them. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation/examples of join syntax and transaction (BEGIN/COMMIT or RPC-wrapped) usage via Supabase client libraries, and independent confirmation that PostgREST-based joins work smoothly at scale.
